headline: National chicken production will reach 25 million in December
summary: President Luis Abinader said national chicken production could reach 25 million units in December. Government institutions have been instructed to prioritize buying Dominican products for Christmas assistance programs.
why: Poultry is a core domestic food supply, and government procurement priorities affect local agricultural producers and food prices.
original_headline: Producción nacional de pollos alcanzará 25 millones en diciembre
